{"code": "
const src = String.raw`import tmp.sheaf.xif.paper.S1780GeometricFiberFintypeActual

noncomputable section
namespace S1780TargetLock

open LeanFormal.IUT.XiFPaper.S1780GeometricFiberFintypeActual
open LeanFormal.IUT.XiFPaper.S1735GeometricFiberActual
open LeanFormal.IUT.XiFPaper.S1735GeometricFiberActual.Paper

#check @S1780BaseChange
#check @S1780Model
#check @S1780ModelOver
#check @S1780Model_finiteEtale
#check @S1780BaseEndomorphism_subsingleton
#check @S1780SubsingletonAlgHomOfField
#check @S1780AlgHomFintype
#check @S1780SectionToFiber
#check @S1780SectionFintype
#check @S1780FiberCovered
#check @S1780FirstMissing
#check @S1780FintypeRequired_of_comparison
#check @S1780FintypeRequired_of_firstMissing

/-- Target lock: the reduction produces exactly the S1735 requirement. -/
example (hfin : ∀ cover : S1735Cover, S1780SectionFintype cover)
    (hcov : ∀ cover : S1735Cover, S1780FiberCovered cover) :
    S1735GeometricFiberFintypeRequired :=
  S1780FintypeRequired_of_comparison hfin hcov

/-- Target lock: the comparison map really lands in the S1735 literal fiber. -/
example (cover : S1735Cover) (s : S1735BaseScheme ⟶ S1780Model cover) :
    S1735Fiber cover :=
  S1780SectionToFiber cover s

end S1780TargetLock
`;
await tools.write({file_path:"D:\\lean\\tmp\\sheaf\\xif\\paper\\S1780TargetLock.lean", content: src});
const r = await tools.pwsh({description:"Compile target-lock probe and hash artifacts", command:
"cd D:\\lean; lake env lean -j1 -R D:\\lean -o .lake\\build\\lib\\lean\\tmp\\sheaf\\xif\\paper\\S1780TargetLock.olean tmp\\sheaf\\xif\\paper\\S1780TargetLock.lean 2>&1 | Out-String; Write-Output ('EXIT=' + $LASTEXITCODE); Write-Output '--- SHA256 ---'; Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 'tmp\\sheaf\\xif\\paper\\S1780GeometricFiberFintypeActual.lean' | Select-Object Hash; Write-Output '--- sizes ---'; Get-Item 'tmp\\sheaf\\xif\\paper\\S1780GeometricFiberFintypeActual.lean','.lake\\build\\lib\\lean\\tmp\\sheaf\\xif\\paper\\S1780GeometricFiberFintypeActual.olean' | Select-Object FullName,Length,LastWriteTime | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String -Width 200; Write-Output '--- lines ---'; (Get-Content 'tmp\\sheaf\\xif\\paper\\S1780GeometricFiberFintypeActual.lean').Count", timeoutMs: 900000});
console.log(r.stdout.text.slice(0,8000));
", "description": "Compile target-lock probe, hash and size artifacts"}
